construction_notes.text: From the state Housing Element Annual Progress Report, through 2025.

SF YIMBY (Jan. 2026): an earlier proposal of a 65-unit affordable senior apartment building and 23 townhouse-style units, filed by AJ Craig Development and Warmington Group, was withdrawn. The new preliminary permits invoke SB 330 and the State Density Bonus Law; the site is roughly two acres between Bowers Avenue and Calabazas Boulevard, last sold in 2022; the applicant is not listed.

SF YIMBY (Dec. 2020) reported development permits filed for 26 townhomes and 62 senior apartments with a rezoning from planned development; the headline gives 2855 and the body gives 2885 El Camino Real.
